        if value is None:

        value = value.decode("utf8")'. Check whether `value` is `None` before attempting to decode it as UTF-8. If `value is None`, skip adding it to `headers` (or `continue`), so unset headers with `None` values are ignored and do not trigger an `AttributeError`.

runtime.final_answer:
Root cause: In `update_headers`, unset headers are represented with `None` as their value. The function calls `value.decode("utf8")` unconditionally on each header value in `request_headers.items()`, causing an `AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'decode'` when an unset header (`None`) is encountered.
Implicated source: file:///Users/rajkumar/Documents/workspace/polya-brain/evals/chapter_13k/fixtures/httpie_unset_header/buggy_impl.py
Correction: replace 'for name, value in request_headers.items():
        value = value.decode("utf8")' with 'for name, value in request_headers.items():
        if value is None:
            continue
        value = value.decode("utf8")'. Check whether `value` is `None` before attempting to decode it as UTF-8. If `value is None`, skip adding it to `headers` (or `continue`), so unset headers with `None` values are ignored and do not trigger an `AttributeError`.
Regression check: Runs `verify(implementation)` with `{"Authorization": None, "X-Request-ID": b"request-7"}` and asserts that the resulting dictionary is `{"X-Request-ID": "request-7"}` without crashing on `None`. (file:///Users/rajkumar/Documents/workspace/polya-brain/evals/chapter_13k/fixtures/httpie_unset_header/check.py).
